author: Jesus Diaz
title: A Map Exclusively Made of Typefaces
quote: This Chicago typographic map is a brilliant design. From the street names that make the streets themselves to the representation of parks and Lake Michigan, it's an exquisite use of typefaces.

author: Jonathan Munetz
title: Review of Typographic Map of Chicago
quote: The authors have put together a map that is crisp and engaging, and is clever without appearing trite.
note: Peer-reviewed journal of the North American Cartographic Information Society. No. 72, pp. 103–106. DOI 10.14714/CP72.200

author: Suzanne LaBarre
title: Infographic of the Day: City Maps Made Only of Typefaces
quote: It's a thoroughly intuitive way to visualize cities. People navigate a new place according to names, not symbols and grids.

author: Nathan Yau
title: Typographic maps
quote: Cartography group Axis Maps continues their run of mapping goodness with the announcement of their typographic maps.

author: Jaime Derringer
title: Typographic Maps by Axis Maps
quote: These typographic maps by Axis Maps take locating a destination to a whole new level.

title: Typographic Streets
quote: We really like the way the fonts have been carefully chosen to match the features on the map and the muted colour scheme.

title: MapCarte 179/365: Typographic maps by Axis Maps, 2010
quote: Here, Axis Maps take a slightly different approach by using typography to build the form of a planimetric map itself.

author: John Krygier
title: Word Maps | Words on Maps | Map Typography
quote: The Axis Typographic Maps use typography as line and area map symbols, providing a nuanced exposition of the geography of these places, the grid of Chicago or the meandering roads of Boston.

author: Jonathan Crowe
title: Typographic Maps of Boston and Chicago
